findings.reason: a node that follows the cited location literally ships a hook that silently never registers for a whole class of workers, and its gate cannot see it.
findings.text: §8 places the merge "after the copy" in `_seed_harness_entry`, but that function opens with `if destination.exists(): return` (`reckon/_worker_fence.py:436`) and the seeding loop skips an entry whose operator source is absent (`_worker_fence.py:249-256`, skip at `:254`), so an operator with no `~/.claude/settings.json` — and any run home already seeded — gets no `settings.json` and therefore no `PostToolUse` entry, while the plan asserts every fenced worker "carries it whatever the operator's settings hold"; the step belongs in the caller `seed_harness_home` (`_worker_fence.py:186`, loop at `:249`), which must also create the file when the copy produced none

findings.reason: without those items the node can pass its whole gate while two stated deliverables are unbuilt and the mechanism is dead in the cases that matter.
findings.text: the done-when's seeding test reads "a seeded Claude-dialect run home carries the `PostToolUse` entry whether or not the operator's settings had hooks", which exercises only the case where `settings.json` exists without a `hooks` key — exactly the case `_seed_harness_entry` already handles — so it cannot fail when the merge step is placed where it no-ops (operator has no settings file, or the home was already seeded); the test list also names no measure for the manifest-contract bullet (quote the message / say none received) or for the coordinator view showing written-but-undelivered messages, leaving two of the four deliverables unfalsifiable

findings.reason: the roadmap orders only declared relationships, so an undeclared wait dispatches §9 against a tree with no hook — but the author may reasonably decline this while §9 stays deferred.
findings.text: §9 is `data-status="deferred"` and its deliverable is to seed "§8's hook" into each codex run home, so it cannot start before §8 lands, yet its section element carries `data-links=""` and the plan declares no section-level dependency, so a coordinator dispatching it from the roadmap sees an unblocked node whose input does not exist
